name: Sea Salt Caramel Mocha Latte
caffeineNote: Label states 200 mg; brand notes contents may vary
summary: Sea salt caramel and mocha on dairy milk, one of the stronger cans we track at 200 mg of caffeine, with 16 g of sugar and 7 g of protein per 11 oz can at 140 calories. Those figures are the whole flavored-latte line’s shared panel rather than anything particular to this can: the Cannoli, French Toast and Cookies & Cream cans all read 16 g of sugar, 5 g of it added, and 7 g of protein at 140 calories, each checked against its own label. A third-party listing showing 33 g for this flavor matches the Cookies N’ Dreams panel from the separate cold brew line, not this one.
